name: typelisp
description: Syntax highlighting and (forthcoming) LSP client for the TypeLisp language.

typelisp.executablePath.description: Path to the `typelisp` executable used to launch the LSP server (`typelisp lsp`). Defaults to `typelisp` on PATH.

typelisp.stdlibRoots.description: Extra `--stdlib-root` directories passed to the TypeLisp tooling.

typelisp.enableLanguageServer.description: Connect to the TypeLisp LSP server (`typelisp lsp`) for diagnostics and editor features once the LSP client glue lands.
